Quiet, mostly: I wanted salt air and a desk where I could finally write my novel. Nobody thought to warn me about the algae.
That simple?
Simple to say and harder to do. The unpacking alone taught me how much sand a single floor can hold. What brought you out here, if you do not mind my asking?

Writing at home until noon, then down here on the beach south of my cabin until half past one. After that I go home again, and I stand on the bridge from three to six.
